documents.title: Electricity Supply Agreement
documents.text:
# Electricity Supply Agreement

This Agreement is made between Northwind Power Ltd (the "Supplier") and Calder Mills plc (the "Customer").

## 2. Supply

2.1 The Supplier shall deliver electricity to the Supply Point continuously during the Supply Period.

2.2 The Customer may nominate a revised Annual Consumption once in each Contract Year.

2.3 The Customer must not resell any electricity supplied under this Agreement to a third party.

## 3. Charges and Payment

3.1 Invoices shall be paid within 30 days of the invoice date.

3.2 If the Customer fails to pay any undisputed invoice by its due date, the Supplier may charge interest at 4% above base rate.

documents.title: Amendment No. 1 to Electricity Supply Agreement
documents.text:
# Amendment No. 1

This Amendment is made between Northwind Power Ltd (the "Supplier") and Calder Mills plc (the "Customer") and amends the Electricity Supply Agreement.

1. Clause 3.1 is deleted and replaced with: "3.1 Invoices shall be paid within 21 days of the invoice date."

2. Clause 2.3 is deleted in its entirety.

3. Save as amended above, the Agreement continues in full force and effect.

description: Hosting variation raises availability commitment; credit and pen-test clauses untouched

documents.title: Managed Hosting Agreement
documents.text:
# Managed Hosting Agreement

Stratocumulus Hosting GmbH (the "Provider") and Pellucid Analytics Ltd (the "Client") agree as follows.

## 3. Service Levels

3.1 The Provider will ensure that the Hosted Platform is Available at least 99.9% of the time in each calendar month.

3.2 Scheduled maintenance must be notified to the Client at least 5 days in advance.

3.3 Should Availability fall below 99.9% in any calendar month, the Provider shall credit the Client with 10% of the monthly Fees.

3.4 The Client shall not perform penetration testing against the Hosted Platform without giving 48 hours' prior notice.

3.5 The Provider may suspend the Services if the Client's usage poses a security risk to other customers.

documents.title: Variation Agreement 2026-01
documents.text:
# Variation Agreement 2026-01

Stratocumulus Hosting GmbH (the "Provider") and Pellucid Analytics Ltd (the "Client") agree to vary the Managed Hosting Agreement with effect from 1 January 2027 as follows:

(a) in clause 3.1, "99.9%" is replaced by "99.95%";

(b) a new clause 3.6 is inserted: "3.6 The Provider shall publish a public status page for the Hosted Platform."

description: Fleet lease amendment removes territory restriction and raises mileage cap

documents.title: Vehicle Fleet Lease
documents.text:
# Vehicle Fleet Lease

This Lease is made between Ridgeway Fleet Leasing Ltd (the "Lessor") and Marlow Couriers Ltd (the "Lessee").

## 7. Use and Return of Vehicles

7.1 The Lessee shall keep each Vehicle insured on a fully comprehensive basis throughout the Lease Term.

7.2 The Lessee shall not permit any Vehicle to be driven outside the United Kingdom.

7.3 Each Vehicle shall be returned with no more than 60,000 miles recorded on its odometer.

7.4 If the recorded mileage on return exceeds 60,000 miles, the Lessee will pay an excess mileage charge of £0.12 per mile.

7.5 The Lessor is entitled to inspect any Vehicle on reasonable notice.

documents.title: Deed of Amendment
documents.text:
# Deed of Amendment

Made between Ridgeway Fleet Leasing Ltd (the "Lessor") and Marlow Couriers Ltd (the "Lessee") in relation to the Vehicle Fleet Lease.

With effect from the date of this Deed:

1. Clause 7.2 shall cease to apply and is removed from the Lease.

2. In clauses 7.3 and 7.4, each reference to "60,000 miles" shall be read as "75,000 miles".

description: Grant amendment letter extends reporting window; overhead cap untouched

documents.title: Research Grant Agreement
documents.text:
# Research Grant Agreement

The Aldermoor Foundation (the "Funder") awards a grant to Harrowgate Institute of Marine Science (the "Grantee") on the following terms.

## 5. Use of Grant and Reporting

5.1 The Grantee shall apply the Grant solely to the Approved Project.

5.2 The Grantee shall submit an annual progress report within 60 days after each anniversary of the Start Date.

5.3 The Funder may withhold any instalment of the Grant if a progress report is overdue.

5.4 No part of the Grant may be used to fund overhead costs exceeding 15% of direct costs.

5.5 Any unspent Grant must be repaid to the Funder within 90 days of the end of the Project Period.

documents.title: Grant Amendment Letter
documents.text:
# Grant Amendment Letter

From: The Aldermoor Foundation (the "Funder")
To: Harrowgate Institute of Marine Science (the "Grantee")

We write to confirm the following amendment to the Research Grant Agreement, effective immediately.

Clause 5.2 is amended so that the annual progress report is due within 90 days after each anniversary of the Start Date (instead of 60 days).

All other terms of the Grant Agreement remain unchanged.
